preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner or marketingWallet address
Contract must hold some token balance (collected taxes) that can be drained

exploit_hint: As the contract owner or marketingWallet address, call getAllTaxes() function to drain all accumulated tax tokens from the contract. This function swaps the contract's token balance for ETH and transfers it to the marketingWallet without any limits. Ensure the contract has accumulated tax tokens from previous transactions first.
